mechanism: The two-week displacement drain from 28 to 20 arrived with almost no structural damage: one channel death on 08-06, no dead-channel URF=0.000 readings, and stability held near 0.84 the whole way down, so the fall was a drain on an intact lattice, not a collapse. At the low the field flipped state: all ten readings across 08-18 and 08-19 carry the reversal flag with the displacement sign inverted, unresolved residual fell from ~0.54 to ~0.34 while normalized force rose to ~2.4, and stability ticked up to 0.865 as price flattened at 20.2-20.7. Tension released on the way down is now being re-absorbed by an intact field turning unanimously against the decline at its edge — a bounce forming, not continuation.
